title: Creating author burdens to reduce paper submissions is STUPID [D]
summary: Over the past two years, conferences have been trying to add different administrative nonsense. Initially, it was author/reviewer sign-up, then reciprocal reviewing, and now CVPR has this author enrollment form that freaks everyone out. I get that we're trying to filter out low-q
reason: Reddit opinion/discussion post complaining about conference submission administrative burdens. No model release, no research artifact (paper/preprint/benchmark), no industry business event, no policy action, and no open-source tool. No rule covers commentary.
